description: Get a Korean statutory interpretation: question (질의요지), answer (회답) and reasons (이유). Interpretations are not law: they are reference material, answers to individual questions, and may change later. id is the number from search_interpretation results (not the item number 안건번호).

id.description: The first number (digits) of a search_interpretation result. Not the item number (안건번호)

name: get_interpretation
title: Get statutory interpretation (법령해석례 보기)
